sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is a canonical static assessment/reference-date term; firstScheduledDryDockingDate is the date to be compared, not the supplied comparison date.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the supplied ship-owned nltl:iceClassDraughtMarkDraughtAmidships quantity, with xsd:decimal numeric value and unit:M, and enforce under each marking-required branch that it is present and equals the linked class certificate's nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtAmidships value. The current presence-only iceClassDraughtMarkPresent check omits the requirement that the mark be located at the maximum permissible ice-class draught amidships.

Remove the NOW()/YEAR()/MONTH()/DAY() logic: DIRECT_STATIC may compare only supplied static RDF state, so the pre-2007 due-or-past branch needs a canonical static assessment/reference-date term and path, which is absent from the scoped vocabulary and must be located by the matcher. Compare firstScheduledDryDockingDate directly with that supplied date, while preserving the rule that complete warning-triangle and draught-mark evidence passes without the docking date and otherwise requires the date until the docking becomes due. Retain the implemented ship-owned mark-draught quantity and its equality to the linked certificate maximum amidships draught.
